headline: Sales grow steadily while acquisition costs pressure EPS
summary_short: Lowe's reported revenue of $23.08B for the quarter ended May 1, 2026, up 10.3% y/y, with comparable sales up 0.6%; diluted EPS was $2.90 (-0.7% y/y) after $96M of acquisition-related charges, while adjusted diluted EPS rose to $3.03.
summary_long: Revenue rose 10.3% y/y to $23.08B on 0.6% comparable-sales growth, 15.5% online growth, and continued strength in Pro, appliances, and home services. Gross profit grew 8.0% y/y to $7.54B (32.68% margin, down from 33.38%); operating income rose 2.4% y/y to $2.55B. GAAP diluted EPS fell 0.7% y/y to $2.90 on $96M of pre-tax FBM/ADG acquisition-integration costs; adjusted diluted EPS rose to $3.03. Net income was $1.63B (-0.8% y/y). The company paid $674M in dividends, repurchased $363M of stock, and affirmed full-year 2026 guidance: sales of $92.0-94.0B, operating margin of 11.2-11.4%, and diluted EPS of $11.75-12.25.

drivers.explanation: Comparable sales rose 0.6% driven by strong spring execution, 15.5% online sales growth, and continued strength in appliances, home services, and Pro sales.
GAAP diluted EPS reflects $96M of pre-tax expenses tied to the Foundation Building Materials and Artisan Design Group acquisitions; excluding these, adjusted diluted EPS rose to $3.03.
Affirmed full-year 2026 outlook: sales of $92.0-94.0B (+7-9%), comparable sales flat to +2%, operating margin 11.2-11.4%, diluted EPS $11.75-12.25, and capex of up to $2.5B.
